thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners/timelines for vendor/dependency mitigations after last night's auth-provider token storm. I sketched items below, pls claim or propose alternate owners.

mira: Thanks. I'll coordinate tracking. Can we keep timelines realistic (no promises before EOD planning)? :calendar:

sre_lead: High-level asks: 1) model-registry fallback dry-run, 2) auth provider circuit-breaker + rotation test, 3) cloud provider backoff/retry tuning + observable spikes.
jordan: I can take the cloud provider retry policy changes. Plan: implement adaptive backoff + add 429/503 jitter in the request layer. ETA: Thu 2026-03-11 EOD.

paula: I'll own the auth circuit-breaker tests and scheduled key-rotation dry-runs. Proposed cadence: weekly drills for 6 weeks, first run Mon 2026-03-08 02:00 UTC. Cron snippet I used in staging: `0 2 * * 1` — can adapt.

alex: @jordan noted. @paula noted. @mira will put these into the incident action tracker and create sub-tasks.

mira: Done — created tracker ticket INF-4821, linked runbook, and added these owners.

opsbot: INF-4821 created by mira. Linked issues: RUNBOOK-77, DEPLOY-9002.

jordan: Quick FYI on scope: i'll change the client retry middleware and add a per-endpoint QPS guard to prevent token storms from amplifying failures. Need a small canary + load test.

paula: For the model-registry fallback dry-run, who will run the actual failover? I can run auth drills but model-registry needs model-team signoff. @sre_lead?

sre_lead: I'll coordinate with model-team. Plan: isolate a non-critical model, simulate registry latency, flip traffic to cached variant. Proposed window: Tue 2026-03-09 03:00-04:00 UTC.

alex: Sounds good. Please ensure rollback steps are in the runbook. Add a pre-flight checklist with telemetry items (latency p95, error-rate, cache-hit ratio).

mira: Adding checklist items now: `preflight: baseline sweep, alert throttle, rollback tag, contact list`.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary-job-2995 -> starts 2026-03-09T03:00:00Z.

jordan: I'll add a test harness snippet to INF-4821: sample backoff config: `maxRetries: 6, baseDelayMs: 100, jitter: true, maxDelayMs: 5000`.

paula: Also proposing a recurring postmortem check-in cadence: weekly for first month, then biweekly for two months, to watch for recurrence patterns.

alex: Agreed. @mira, please set reminders and link the recurring calendar invites. We'll review progress in next SRE sync.

mira: Calendar invites sent. First review: 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC.

sre_lead: One more: confirm vendor SLA escalations and contact handoffs. I will own vendor comms update. ETA Fri 2026-03-12.

alex: Thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll treat these as committed. I'll close the thread once INF-4821 has the tickets and schedules attached. :white_check_mark:

mira: INF-4821 now has subtasks and scheduled times. Closing loop here unless new blockers.

paula: ACK. I'll post results after first drill.

jordan: ACK, will link test logs to the ticket.

opsbot: INF-4821 status: in-progress.

alex: Closing for now — reopening if anything slips. Appreciate the quick turn.
